skills.description: Give an AI agent the correct local gateway details for text chat.
skills.gatewayDescription: Copy these instructions into your AI client. The endpoint key is a placeholder and is never read from this page.
skills.instructions:
Use this CLIProxyAPI gateway for text chat.
Base URL: {baseURL}
Authentication: Authorization: Bearer <ENDPOINT_API_KEY>
First, request GET {baseURL}/models and choose a model ID from the response.
Send chat requests to POST {baseURL}/chat/completions with the selected model and messages.
Set stream=true to receive server-sent events; stop reading when data: [DONE] arrives.
Use an endpoint API key from the user. Never use or request the management password.
